title: Route M3.1 promotion lane to promotion verifier
purpose: Recognize the exact governed M3.1 promotion branch in the legacy Learn-it Next router and delegate semantic verification to the dedicated M3.1 promotion rebind workflow while preserving fail-closed behavior for every other unknown product branch.
invariants: Only the legacy Learn-it Next CI router and this work-package file may change.
The existing M3.1 implementation delegated route remains unchanged.
The exact M3.1 promotion branch is the only new recognized branch.
The new route is delegation-only and never claims to execute promotion semantics.
Delegation requires the frozen product work package and workflow in the promotion delta, an authoring/v2 product change, and the dedicated promotion verifier already present on the PR base.
Every other unknown product-relevant branch remains fail-closed.
Rename/copy-aware product relevance logic remains unchanged.
Repository governance, PR scope, product code, product tests and promotion verifier semantics are untouched.
requiredEvidence: Learn-it Next CI self-audit PASS on the CI-WP-006 branch.
Existing M3.1 implementation route string remains unchanged.
Promotion delegated block requires exact branch, canonical work package, frozen product workflow, authoring/v2 change and verifier presence on PR base.
adversarialTests: Exact M3.1 promotion branch with required conditions delegates successfully.
Promotion branch missing frozen product workflow fails.
Promotion branch missing canonical product work package fails.
Promotion branch without authoring/v2 product change fails.
Promotion branch whose base lacks the dedicated verifier fails.
Any other unknown product branch remains fail-closed.
Existing M3.1 implementation route still delegates exactly as before.
nonGoals: Executing or accepting M3.1 promotion semantics in the legacy router.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope provide independent repository-level review.
The workflow executes its existing ci-router self-test on this workflow-only change.
rollback: Revert the single promotion delegated route block and CI-WP-006 metadata; the promotion branch returns to fail-closed behavior.
